title: pvExtractLocation
body:
## pvExtractLocation

Looks up one point in space: in Interpolate At Location mode it outputs a single point with all data interpolated there (a probe); in Extract Cell At Location mode, the ParaView default, it outputs the cell or cells containing the location with their data. Use it for a monitoring-point value or to inspect the element at a position; use probeLine or pvPlotOverLine for lines.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- A location outside the mesh gives an empty result (or zero-filled values when interpolating); check the bounds.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `ExtractLocation`. Identity: `filters/ExtractLocation`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: Set the input dataset producer. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet); composite data (multiblock or partitioned collections) (vtkCompositeDataSet). The input needs at least one point- or cell-centred array. | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet","vtkCompositeDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Location` | Select the location of interest in 3D space. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `Mode` | Select whether to interpolate (probe) data attributes at the specified location, or to extract cell(s) containing the specified location. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Interpolate At Location","Extract Cell At Location"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Interpolate At Location"` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvExtractLocation",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
